acceptance.component: FP8 p50 interval-union attention time is >=10% lower at every engine-valid selected point
acceptance.mechanism: FP8 DRAM read bytes <=60% of BF16 at every row and byte reduction increases with context while launch count is unchanged
acceptance.reject_as_compute_or_launch_limited: DRAM bytes fall but elapsed saving stays below the whole-request hurdle, or speedup is context-invariant and explained by launch count/cycles instead.
acceptance.whole_request: Architecture-weight 50 local layers*358 steps and 10 global layers over all contexts 4214..4571; measured saving must be >=0.0273987616 s/request.

checkpoint_free_exact_shape_measurement.hardware: one full NVIDIA H100 SXM, TP=1
minimal_counters: dram__bytes_read.sum over the exact NVTX attention range
kernel launch count and interval-union elapsed time
checkpoint_free_exact_shape_measurement.oracle: The timed output is consumed; compare FP8 output against the same nonzero BF16 paged output with cosine similarity >=0.99 and normalized RMSE <=0.05 on every row.
checkpoint_free_exact_shape_measurement.producer_consumer: Invoke unified_kv_cache_update with deterministic nonzero K/V, then the actual selected paged backend using block_table, slot_mapping, and seqused_k; a dense varlen stand-in or direct kernel fixture without the cache producer fails.
checkpoint_free_exact_shape_measurement.required_runtime_binding: One immutable image must report the named vLLM revision or exact six-file hash set; construct actual local/global Attention modules and record selected backend classes before timing.
checkpoint_free_exact_shape_measurement.timing: 20 warmups then 100 randomized paired repetitions per row; alternate arm order; CUDA events plus synchronized wall time; setup and allocation excluded

decision_question: Can one pinned-source H100 paged-attention dataflow change plausibly save at least 5% whole-request cost and be falsified checkpoint-free?

correction_to_prior_floor.reason: Local K and V each contain 16*256 BF16 scalars; only global 4*512 K plus V equals 8192 bytes per token per layer.

evidence_boundary: No GPU, checkpoint, provider, compilation, or H100 throughput measurement was used. The >=5% result is an exact-shape byte/roofline plausibility bound and a falsifier, not achieved speed, quality, endpoint throughput, or economic acceptance.

geometry.pattern: five sliding_attention then one full_attention, repeated

mechanism.change: Use the pinned runtime's actual FP8 E4M3 KV producer and the same paged FlashAttention/Triton consumers for all 50 local and 10 global layers; do not change window, page table, heads, dimensions, layer pattern, or scheduling.
mechanism.semantics: quantized-KV semantics change; checkpoint-free component accuracy is required before any endpoint claim
mechanism.why_h100: SM90 natively supports FP8, both pinned paged consumers expose an FP8 path, and exact attention arithmetic intensity is far below H100's BF16 roofline balance.

hierarchy: Q/K/V are produced per decoder layer and normalized; new K/V are quantized and written to paged HBM cache slots.
The scheduler supplies slot_mapping, block_table, sequence lengths, and query offsets to the layer backend.
Local 16x256 pages are window-pruned to 1024 tokens; global 4x512 pages traverse the full 4214..4571 context.
FlashAttention or Triton gathers physical pages through L2 into SM registers/shared-memory tiles, performs QK/softmax/AV, and writes BF16 attention output.
The 50 MiB L2 is only 1.4% to 17.5% of one selected c8..c32 batch-step KV working set, so the exact paged reads cannot reside there as a whole.

image_boundary.interpretation: The cached image is useful source-level corroboration but is not an execution-equivalent binding for the frontier revision; a later GPU falsifier must bind one immutable image to the named source revision.

source_files.observation: Each layer performs QKV projection, Q/K/V normalization and RoPE, then its own Attention call before o_proj; local/global layers are not adjacent attention calls and cannot be fused across the MLP/residual boundary.
cache_config.cache_dtype selects BF16/FP8; unified_kv_cache_update writes paged K and V before unified_attention_with_output consumes the page table.
SM90 backend priority is FlashAttention, FlashInfer, Triton, Flex.
Paged FlashAttention consumes block_table/seqused_k; FA3 on SM90 accepts FP8 KV and head_size<=256, while head_size 512 requires FA4.
Triton paged attention supports head_size>=32 and FP8 on SM89+; global 4x512 therefore has an SM90 fallback when FA4 is absent.
The kernel follows block_table physical pages, loads K and V, dequantizes quantized caches inline, and uses 16-way segmented softmax when the decode grid is below its threshold.

rejected_mechanisms.name: single fused five-local/one-global attention kernel
rejected_mechanisms.reason: The six attention calls occur in six different decoder layers with o_proj, residual/norm, and MLP dependencies between them; their K/V caches also belong to different layers. There is no scheduler-adjacent six-call boundary.

rejected_mechanisms.name: K-equals-V one-copy global cache
rejected_mechanisms.reason: The source duplicates projection weights but applies different K norm+RoPE and V norm before cache update, and the paged consumer reads distinct K/V arrays.
